# ============================================================
# BC408-equivalent plastic scintillator (Buapfcfm)
# Used by this paper's end-to-end and lens variant scenarios.
#
# Spec:
#   n ≈ 1.58  (constant over 2.1–3.1 eV)
#   density = 1.032 g/cm3
#   yield = 1000 photons/MeV  (reduced for simulation efficiency)
#   fast time constant = 2.1 ns
#   emission spectrum: 300 bins, 2.07–3.10 eV (peak ≈ 2.95 eV ≈ 420 nm)
#
# Reference: BC408 datasheet (Saint-Gobain); PVT-based.
# Naming: "Buapfcfm" retained to preserve compatibility with prior
#   simulation runs (fluence_offset_analysis.md, Fix 45 series).
# ============================================================
